name: Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
oracle_text:
The first activated ability of an artifact you activate each turn costs {2} less to activate.
+1: Draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
−2: Target artifact becomes an artifact creature. If it isn't a Vehicle, it has base power and toughness 4/4.
−6: You get an emblem with "Whenever an artifact you control becomes tapped, draw a card."
blocked_sentences: −2: Target artifact becomes an artifact creature. If it isn't a Vehicle, it has base power and toughness 4/4.

needs.what: an `animate` of a TARGET permanent (not the Vehicle itself) that adds the Creature type with no duration and leaves its base power and toughness alone when it is a Vehicle (301.7c: a Vehicle that becomes a creature keeps its printed P/T), so the -2 reads `if` the target is a Vehicle -> animate types [Creature], duration permanent, keep_pt; else -> the same with power/toughness 4/4 -- i.e. `keep_pt: true` accepted on a `{"target": ...}` pool guarded to Vehicles
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `animate`'s `keep_pt` is refused by the loader unless `objects` is `self_only` (crew's Vehicle animating itself), and without it a creature animation must name `power`/`toughness`; writing `power_of`/`toughness_of` the target snapshots the numbers into a layer 7b base-P/T effect with this ability's timestamp instead of leaving the printed 7a values, which a Vehicle with a characteristic-defining or later-set P/T answers differently. The first line (`ability_cost_reduction` with `first_each_turn`), the +1 (Thirst for Knowledge's `may` pay discard of an artifact card, else discard two) and the -6 (`emblems` + `emblem` op with a `becomes_tapped` trigger filtered to artifacts you control) are expressible
